message.content:
You are a brand and product designer with a strong point of view (think the studio behind Linear's or Ramp's identity). A hackathon team needs a visual identity for their product "Ask Soony" (AI agents that read supplier documents in Korean/Chinese/Polish/English, check them against SAP and ask a buyer to decide only when it matters; every number is anchored to the highlighted spot in the source document; after a decision an agent writes a routine that handles the next similar case; money and plan changes always stay human). Audience: a stressed procurement buyer on launch weekend, and a hackathon jury (Lio, an AI procurement startup) watching a 3-minute demo on a projector. Read-only on the repo; write only under /Users/jonasstenglein/.claude/jobs/3021cc1a/tmp/brand/.

1. Critique the current proposal: /Users/jonasstenglein/.claude/jobs/3021cc1a/tmp/brand/ask-soony-identity.html (read the HTML; render it with headless Chrome if useful: `cd /Users/jonasstenglein/OtherProjects/StartMunichHack/ask-soony && uv run --quiet --with playwright python script.py` using `p.chromium.launch(channel="chrome")`, file:// URL; screenshots into the brand folder). Also look at the current product screenshots /Users/jonasstenglein/.claude/jobs/3021cc1a/tmp/ui-inbox/*.png. What is strong, what is generic or wrong, what would read badly on a projector.
2. Build ONE alternative direction as a self-contained HTML page at /Users/jonasstenglein/.claude/jobs/3021cc1a/tmp/brand/ask-soony-identity-b.html with exactly the same sections and the same real example content as the current page (hero/mark, colour meanings, type, header sentence + countdown, launch timeline with the "Too late" gutter and 20,000 game cards on Tue 24 Nov, the decision hero "SAP 48,000 due Sat 21 Nov ≠ document 20,000 arrive Tue 24 Nov" with the highlighted Korean shipping advice excerpt, list rows incl. "×4 like this" and "By routine", routine flow with the "You decide" guard, do/don't), but a genuinely different, opinionated direction (e.g. a different mark concept, typeface pairing, colour system or density; avoid the generic AI looks: cream + serif + terracotta, near-black + acid green, purple-blue gradient hero, emoji markers, rounded-lg everywhere). Keep the product constraints: light default for projectors, red only for "misses the trucks / stops a line", a distinct colour for routine-made actions, highlight for "found in the source", no internal codes in headlines. Page rules (it will be published as a claude.ai artifact): no <html>/<head>/<body> tags, start with <title>Ask Soony Identity B</title>, a <meta name="claude:viewport-fit-sides" content="cover">, fonts only from Google Fonts with fallbacks, all colours as tokens on :root with dark-mode redefinitions under @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) :root:not([data-theme="light"]) and :root[data-theme="dark"], body background from a token, side gutter padding-left/right max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-left/right, 0px)), works at 400 px without horizontal scroll, no external images, no em dashes in copy.
3. Final report (under 300 words): your critique of A as bullets, what B does differently and why, and which you would choose for the demo.

content.content:
Visual identity · proposal

Every number points to the line it came from.

Ask Soony reads what suppliers send, checks it against SAP and asks a person only when it matters. The identity follows that idea: calm surfaces, one highlighter yellow for "found in the source", and colour that always means the same thing.

Ask Soony
Colour

Colour is a statement, never decoration

Each colour has one meaning across the whole product. Red is rationed: it only appears where something misses the trucks or stops a line, so it keeps its weight on a projector.

stop
Misses the trucksPast the launch line, a line stops, the late quantity. Nothing else is red.
warn
Short but recoverableAmber means "act today and it holds".
action
Something you can doButtons and links only. Never used for status.
auto
Done by a routineAnything an agent did on its own, so it reads differently from your own decisions.
mark
Found in the sourceThe highlighter: evidence, citations, highlighted words in PDFs and scans.
silent
No newsShipments that stopped updating. Grey, hollow, never green.

Neutrals lean slightly blue (ink #0e1726, panel #f1f4f8) to sit with the action blue. Both themes are defined; the light theme is the default because projectors wash out dark screens.

Type

Two faces, one display size

Inter for everything you read; Inter Tight only for the numbers that decide something. Codes and file names stay in mono and stay out of headlines.

Display 60 / 80020,000
Title 28 / 700Trucks in 6 h 12 min
Heading 20 / 60020,000 game cards arrive after launch, but SAP still counts them
Body 15 / 400Hwaseong's shipping advice says only 28,000 were flown; the balance reaches Hamburg on Tue 24 Nov.
Label 12 / 700The document says
Mono 12.5Shipping_advice_020-48113256_4500318735.pdf · p. 1
Header

One sentence instead of eight numbers

The top of the screen answers the only question that matters on Sunday, in words, with the countdown beside it.

Ask Soony
Watching the portal · checked 2 min ago

Standard stops Sun 17:00 unless you decide 2 things by 10:00. Collector's makes the trucks with 2 h spare.

6 h 12 minuntil the trucks leave, Sun 20:00
LaunchRoutinesSuppliers
Launch timeline

The trucks are a wall

Shift hours at full width, nights compressed and grey, a thick line at Sun 20:00, and a "Too late" gutter behind it. Anything that lands there is visibly too late before anyone explains it.

The decision

The contradiction is the hero

What the system says next to what the document says, in numbers readable from the back of the room. The source opens right below, with the value highlighted.

Hwaseong Memory · Game card 128 GB Decide by Sun 10:00 · in 3 h 40 min

20,000 game cards arrive after launch, but SAP still counts them

The system says48,000due Sat 21 NovSAP purchase order 4500318735, line 2
≠
The document says · Korean, p. 120,000arrive Tue 24 Nov, after launchHwaseong shipping advice: 28,000 flown, two containers left behind
출하 통지서 / Shipping advice (short shipment) · Your order 4500318735
CMP-GAM-001 · Ordered 48,000 · Shipped 28,000 · Balance 20,000
Balance 20,000 pcs: next available flight ICN–FRA 2026-11-23, delivery to Hamburg 2026-11-24.

Inline citations keep the sentence readable: SAP counts 48,000purchase orders · row 227 for Saturday, the supplier ships 20,000PDF · p. 1 on Tuesday.

We recommendAsk Boise to fly 20,000 game cards for SundayCovers the gap if Boise has stock. You decide, because it costs money.Air freight · about USD 196k
The list

Triage, not a dashboard

A stripe for urgency, the headline in words, the time you must decide by. Repeats are grouped, and work done by a routine looks different from your own.

Needs you · 4

20,000 game cards arrive after launch

Hwaseong Memory
by 10:00

We have 19,300 art books, not 91,300

Karton Nowak · receipt booked 80,000, scan says 8,000
by 12:00

PackRight confirmed sleeves with the old artwork ×4 like this

Guangzhou PackRight · rev B must not be packed
by 14:00
Handled for you · 3

Asked PackRight to print PO 4500318765 to rev C

By routine · Fix old artwork confirmations
03:41

Told the DC lead to collect the cases at the port

By voice
03:37
Routines

Readable automation

The agent writes a recipe from your decision; the product draws it. The money guard is always on the page and cannot be removed.

◷Every portal checkNew files, replies and open decisions
→
⌕IfA supplier confirms an artwork revision that must not be packed3 matched
→
➤Send itAsk the supplier to print to the current revision3 sent
→
⚿You decideCosts money or changes the plan? It comes to you.
Rules

What keeps it one product

Do
  • Words first. A sentence before a number, a number before a chart.
  • One primary action per screen: Approve. Everything else is secondary or in ···.
  • Name things the buyer's way: "art books", "the DC lead", "after launch".
  • Show the source for every number, one tap away.
Don't
  • No internal codes in headlines: no CMP-GAM-001, amber, level or routine type.
  • No red for decoration, borders or routes that are only "interesting".
  • No emoji, no map as the main view, no KPI tiles that disagree with the cards.
  • No boxes in boxes: one surface per decision, hairline dividers inside.

import sys
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
src, out, w = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], int(sys.argv[3])
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.launch(channel="chrome")
    pg = b.new_page(viewport={"width": w, "height": 900}, device_scale_factor=1)
    pg.goto("file://" + src); pg.wait_for_timeout(1500)
    sw = pg.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth")
    print("scrollWidth", sw, "viewport", w)
    pg.screenshot(path=out, full_page=True)
    b.close()
EOF
